question: Why does Luffy always refuse to kill his enemies? When reading the manga, he didn't kill Mohji, and he also didn't kill Helmeppo or Captain Morgan. Morgan was killed by Zoro, but why?
answer: Ah, that's a good question. First of all, Morgan is still alive. Right now, he is in prison thanks to his former subordinates. Why not kill him? In this era, people are risking their lives for their beliefs and fighting for them. Luffy is shattering his enemies' beliefs in battle. For enemies, having their beliefs crushed and being defeated is equivalent to experiencing pain as if they were dead. I believe, the question of whether to kill or not is secondary; winning or losing is what matters to those pirates.
name: Zoro
